title: MoonMail
summary: Browser mailbox for encrypted Ootle letters, recoverable Inbox/Sent and preferences; it does not send ordinary email. November 4, 2026: the landing and privacy pages load, but the public hall cannot reach its post office and no live mail loaded. The cause is not established. Sapient private-view access is a separate account-wide grant exposing other resources’ private amounts and memos; spending needs separate approval. Public postbox identities, signers, timing, fees and size buckets remain observable. Historical mailbox-key compromise has no forward-secrecy protection. Private payments require three approvals with non-atomic transfer and receipt delivery. Public/link gifts expose vault amounts and have no expiry or sender refund; complete private links grant bearer access. The README targets Ootle 0.47 and Sapient 0.6.14, separating historical funded tests from dated read-only recovery and local tests. The November 2 organizer notice asked entrants to republish templates after the Esmeralda reset. The retained October 29 recording shows public privacy documentation, not current mail delivery or payment. MIT source; no wallet grant or transaction exercised.
cardSummary: Exchange encrypted letters between Ootle postboxes and recover conversations, sent mail and saved settings through Sapient.
